name: rig
description: Local runtime context for AI coding agents. Cloud MCP for project status, health, ports, and gated start/stop/restart — plus skills to install and link the Mac hub.

rig_account_pat.title: Rig account token
rig_account_pat.description: Optional account PAT from the Rig dashboard. Leave blank to sign in with browser OAuth. Stored as a sensitive plugin option and sent only as the Authorization header to https://api.userig.app/mcp. Do not paste a local hub token.
